basic_details.job_title: BHEL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Project Engineer, Project Supervisor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (A Govt. of India Undertaking) Solar Business Division, Bengaluru, has invited applications for 3 Project Engineer (FTA Gr II) and 3 Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III) posts in Solar PV erection and commissioning. The posts are on fixed tenure for an initial 16 months or till completion of the assignment, whichever is earlier. The pay is an all-inclusive consolidated Rs. 84,000 per month in the first year for Project Engineers and Rs. 45,000 per month in the first year for Project Supervisors. Candidates need a full-time degree (Engineers) or diploma (Supervisors)

Pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 236/- online through NEFT/UPI, using the link on the website, if the fee applies to your category. Demand Draft, Money Order, Postal Order and Cheque are not accepted.

After submitting, print the application format that carries the unique acknowledgement No.
Send the printout with the fee receipt/transaction copy (where applicable) and self-attested documents to: Addl GM/ HR, BHEL-SBD, Prof CNR Rao Circle, IISc Post, Bengaluru – 560012, Karnataka.

Class X (High School) certificate for date of birth

OBC certificate and self-undertaking (undertaking format) by the OBC non-creamy layer candidate; the certificate must be not more than one year old from the date of application to BHEL
Relevant certificate, if claiming age relaxation as a candidate from J&K
Mark sheets of all semesters/consolidated mark sheet of Degree/Diploma, and the pass certificate of Degree/Diploma
Proof of the University/Institute norms for converting CGPA/OGPA/DGPA into percentage

A certificate in a language other than Hindi or English must come with a certified translation in Hindi or English at the time of interview, if called.
important_instructions: Candidates employed in Govt./Semi-Govt./Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous bodies must produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview, and a relieving order from their organisation if selected. BHEL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge or reopen the recruitment process and to increase or decrease vacancies without notice. Posts may be kept unfilled at the management's discretion. content_sections.heading: About the Company
content_sections.text: BHEL describes itself as a Public Sector Undertaking incorporated in 1964, serving sectors including power, transportation, defence, aerospace, oil and gas, and process industries. These posts are for BHEL's Solar Business Division, Bengaluru, and the selected candidates report to the Project Director/Site-In-charge at the project site.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: BHEL has notified 6 vacancies in total: 3 Project Engineer and 3 Project Supervisor posts. The notice calls the number tentative and says the actual requirement may vary based on further assessment. Reservation for Persons with Disability and Ex-servicemen will be as per Government directives. Vacancies reserved for OBC are meant only for Non-Creamy Layer candidates. Where reservation points are not available, candidates may apply subject to meeting the general eligibility standards and will be considered under UR.

rows.post: Project Engineer (FTA Gr II) – Electrical 1, Civil 1, Mechanical 1
Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III) – Electrical 1, Civil 2

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals need to apply. The required qualification and experience must be held as on 16.12.2026. Marks required are minimum 60% in aggregate for General/OBC candidates and 50% in aggregate for SC/ST candidates. Where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA or a letter grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage must be shown in the form, with proof of the university's conversion norms. FTA-1 Electrical and FTA-4 Project Supervisor Electrical share the same experience rule. Essential: minimum 2 years' work experience in installation and commissioning of any of the following: Photovoltaic systems Power Plant Control, Monitoring and Associated system Instrumentation and PLC system Power electronic system (inverters, UPS drives, rectifiers) SCADA system/HVDC and Reactive power management Switchyard substations FTA-2 Civil and FTA-5 Project Supervisor Civil share the same rule. Essential: minimum 2 years' work experience in civil works associated with any of Solar Power Projects, Thermal power Projects, Infrastructure Projects, Industrial Construction Projects, or Residential/Commercial Construction Projects. Desirable: knowledge in Civil Quality standards. FTA-3 Mechanical. Essential: minimum 2 years' work experience in mechanical installation works associated with any of Solar Power Projects, Thermal power Projects, Infrastructure Projects, or Industrial Projects. Desirable: experience in erection of tracker based solar PV plant. FTA-4 Electrical (1 post) follows the Electrical experience rule listed above, and FTA-5 Civil (2 posts) follows the Civil rule listed above, each with minimum 2 years' experience. The experience must be exclusive of any trainee or apprenticeship period. Candidates without relevant post-qualification experience need not apply. The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.11.2026 for both posts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are paid an all-inclusive monthly consolidated remuneration. Medical benefit: reimbursement of the premium paid for a Mediclaim Policy up to Rs. 5 lakhs for self, spouse and dependent children. Selected candidates are covered under BHEL's Group Personal Accident Policy. The posts are purely temporary, offered on fixed tenure for an initial 16 months or completion of the assignment, whichever is earlier. They are not against any permanent vacancy and give no entitlement to regular or permanent employment in BHEL.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All eligible applications are screened against the eligibility conditions, and candidates who fulfil them are called for a Personal Interview. If more eligible applications are received, candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:10 to the number of vacancies in each category, in order of merit. Merit is based on marks in the qualifying examination (Degree/Diploma as applicable). Shortlisted candidates are informed individually by e-mail, at the address given in the application form. The interview date and venue are not mentioned in the notice. BHEL verifies eligibility against original documents after the candidate is called for interview, and the candidature stays provisional at all stages. Before joining, selected candidates undergo a medical examination by the Company's Authorized Medical Officer/Govt Officer. No relaxation in health standards is allowed. Candidates called for interview are reimbursed second class onward and return train fare by the shortest route, from the starting station or mailing address, whichever is nearer to the place of interview, subject to production/verification of train tickets.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The far flung date applies to candidates residing in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Jammu & Kashmir, Lahaul & Spiti District, Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, or abroad.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 tentative vacancies: 3 Project Engineer (FTA Gr II) and 3 Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III) posts. The actual requirement may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BHEL FTA 01/2026?
faq.answer: Online submission closes on 16 December 2026. The printed application with documents must reach BHEL by 23 December 2026 (16.30 hrs), or by 28 December 2026 from far flung areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BHEL Project Engineer and Project Supervisor?
faq.answer: Project Engineers need a full-time degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical, Civil or Mechanical. Project Supervisors need a full-time diploma in Electrical or Civil. Both need minimum 60% (50% for SC/ST) and 2 years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.11.2026. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), with further relaxations for PwD and certain J&K domiciles.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for BHEL Project Engineer and Project Supervisor?
faq.answer: Project Engineers get Rs. 84,000 per month in the first year and Rs. 88,000 in the second year. Project Supervisors get Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 48,000 respectively, all-inclusive and consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BHEL FTA 01/2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs. 236/- for UR and OBC (NCL) candidates. SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen are exempted. It is paid online through NEFT/UPI.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at careers.bhel.in, print the application with its acknowledgement No., and post it with documents to Addl GM/ HR, BHEL-SBD, Prof CNR Rao Circle, IISc Post, Bengaluru – 560012, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible applications are screened and candidates are called for a Personal Interview. If applications are many, they are shortlisted 1:10 in order of merit, based on Degree/Diploma marks.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary, on fixed tenure for an initial 16 months or completion of the assignment, whichever is earlier, and give no right to regular employment in BHEL.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the BHEL project staff be posted?
faq.answer: The posts are at the 450MW Solar PV Project at Village Doddagatta/Elanji/Kudulur, District Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, reporting to the Project Director/Site-In-charge.
